title: HDI Component Improvements
subject: Economics
caption: Grouped bar chart comparing 2019 and 2020 values of India's HDI components.
altText: A grouped bar chart with four categories (Life expectancy, Expected years of schooling, Mean years of schooling, GNI per capita). For each category two vertical bars are shown: a light gray bar representing the 2019 value and a blue bar representing the 2020 value. Bars are scaled within each category so the 2020 bar reaches the top of the chart. Numeric values are labeled above each bar. The x‑axis lists the four categories, and a legend identifies the colors for 2019 and 2020.
